trader_lines: Safe enough to camp here now, thanks to you. Have a look at what I carry.
I go from camp to camp. Wherever the beasts are gone, there's trade.
Rest by the fire if you need it. Nobody comes out of those woods any more.
settler_lines: We came when we heard the lair was cleared. These old walls will do for a start.
My grandmother was born in this place, before it fell. We are taking it back.
The children sleep at night now. That is your doing.
We'll have a roof on before winter, and a field turned by spring.
Travellers stop here again. Some of them stay.
